name: {{publisherNamespace}}/northcinder-mcp
title: NorthCinder client for a separately operated engine
description: Advanced MCP client for a separately operated NorthCinder engine. It does not bundle local mode.

environmentVariables.name: NORTHCINDER_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Set to self-hosted for this separately operated engine template.

environmentVariables.name: NORTHCINDER_SERVICE_URL
environmentVariables.description: HTTPS base URL of the NorthCinder engine you operate; explicit loopback HTTP is also allowed.

environmentVariables.name: NORTHCINDER_CLIENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Buyer-generated key for your NorthCinder engine; not an AI model-provider token.
